The '''''Dakkrakk''''' was a [[Container transport]] under the employ of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The transport was supposed to arrive at the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] massing near [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], but was [[Ambush at Sul-34|destroyed]] at [[Sul-34]] by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] in a [[Missile Boat]].
